label: 🏠 Welcome
description: Landing page and overview

label: 🧭 Engagement context
description: The contractual & infrastructure frame (MSC / MSI / STA) and customer name — sets reachable maturity, glass ceiling, ramp speed, billable setup, the decision-risk bar and the case NPV discount rate. Extracted from Parameters.

label: 🤝 Engage
description: Starting early with the client: the four gated onboarding stages (Discover → Calibrate → Validate → Pilot & Prove) and how long each runs, plus the engagement roadmap and its gates. Extracted from the S-curve timing card (v18.6).

label: 🏛️ Industry / regulatory profile
description: Industry / regulatory profile and cross-cutting norms (AI, sustainability, usability) that add regulated artifacts to the scope, driving the glass ceiling. Extracted from Parameters.

label: 🎯 Automation & Glass ceiling
description: The two levers that set how deep automation can go: target automation potential and the effective regulatory glass ceiling.

label: 📊 S-curve — adoption ramp
description: The three-year adoption ramp (Y1/Y2/Y3): the share of automation potential realized each year, cascading into headcount, cost and ROI. Moved out of Parameters.

label: 📐 Maturity levels (L1–L4)
description: The single definition of the four maturity thresholds (adoption + agent-vFTE share) that drive every L1–L4 marker and maturity read-out — one source of truth. First in Tune (v18.6).

label: 🧭 AI Readiness
description: 10-dimension questionnaire, 0-100 index with radar chart and per-dimension bars

label: 🎯 Scope
description: Select SDLC and regulatory artifacts by phase, driving glass ceiling and effort

label: 🎯 Phase scope
description: Quick phase-level scope: toggle whole SDLC phases in/out, with live effort share, glass-ceiling contribution and human supervision per phase. Extracted from Guided Setup.

label: 📊 Product status lifecycle weighting
description: Product-status lifecycle weighting: pick where the product sits (greenfield to legacy) to re-weight phase effort. Extracted from Scope.

label: 📊 Status & phase weight
description: Editable per-phase weight matrix and automation posture for each product status

label: Input team
description: AS-IS team composition: skill × grade × location × ETP

label: Rate Card
description: Day rate matrix editable per skill/grade/location

label: 🌍 Location strategy
description: Target location mix for the residual team

label: 💸 Token economics
description: LLM pricing catalog, mix, blended cost per 1M tokens

label: 🧠 Knowledge hub
description: Living memory CC0–CC4: potential multiplier, Monte Carlo variance reducer, avoided KT cost (EV-10)

label: 🤖 Run-team sizing
description: How the agentic run team (AgentOps) is sized: hybrid floor + per-agent policy, configurable. Also hosts the residual-team supervision-share cap/factor.

label: 📒 Assumptions register
description: Every model assumption: current vs default, status, client validation, measured impact

label: FTE / vFTE
description: Human FTE vs Agent vFTE trajectory year by year

label: vFTE Overview
description: Agent vFTE composition breakdown

description: TO-BE team composition after transformation

label: 🧩 Operating model
description: Pods, transverse roles and AI Office re-projected from the TO-BE volume — V7 conservation (EV-09)

label: 👥 TO-BE team by skill
description: Residual human FTE and agent vFTE per skill, derived from artefact allocation

label: 🎲 Monte Carlo
description: Probabilistic exploration of the business case: distribution, P10/P50/P90, sensitivity

label: 📊 Stochastic layer (P4)
description: P4 · seeded Monte Carlo over the P1/P3 economic drivers (Beta/Triangular/Lognormal, one-factor Gaussian copula), tornado, convergence trace, plus counterfactual baseline drift — gross vs. attributable savings (AME-SPEC P4). A separate layer alongside the existing Monte Carlo tab.

label: Phase / Artifact detail
description: Detailed breakdown by lifecycle phase and artifact

label: Agent Directory
description: Execution agents by authorization level and operational roles, filtered by phase — plus the agentic loop pairs

label: 🤖 Agent details
description: Individual agent role allocations and workloads

label: 📊 Agent usage
description: Runs, tokens, cost per agent role

label: 🔁 Loop convergence
description: P1 · acceptance-driven iteration economics: E[N], escape rate, cost-per-accepted, effective multiplier and human-review share per agentic loop pair (AME-SPEC P1). Display-only.

label: 🧑‍✈️ Supervision (P3)
description: P3 · supervision priced as a decision: Provisioned (solve headcount, price it, never cap) or Constrained (fix headcount, cap achievable agent capacity) — plus the DORA read-out pulled forward from P5 (AME-SPEC P3).

label: Agentic Setup
description: Setup costs breakdown (tooling, training, coaching, governance)

label: Agentic Run
description: Recurring run costs (team, tokens, infra, agentic run team)

label: Annual summary
description: Year 1/2/3 summary table with costs and savings

label: Monthly detail
description: 36-month disaggregation of costs and savings

label: 🎬 Monthly Playback
description: Animated VCR-style playback of the trajectory, month by month, across FTE, cost, savings, velocity and cost per point (EV-30)

label: Execution Timeline
description: Timeline of the transformation programme

label: Productivity
description: Productivity metrics per FTE (throughput, quality)

label: Velocity
description: Delivery velocity metrics (lead time, cycle time)

label: Quality

label: Compliance
description: Regulatory compliance coverage view

label: 💳 Financial
description: ROI, NPV, payback, workforce shift, cash flow, break-even

label: ⏱️ Flow & value (P5)
description: P5 - Little's Law cycle time (throttled by P3 supervision), and the sponsor-owned time-to-market NPV of arriving earlier - with an explicit cost-out/throughput-in split so the same freed capacity is never counted twice (AME-SPEC P5, strategic bet).

label: 📅 Gantt / Timeline
description: Whole-engagement timeline: transformation program (Discover→Pilot, Agentic Build, Agentic Run), SDLC phases in V-cycle order, and every artefact placed in its phase

label: 📊 Board
description: Configuration surface for operator-created dynamic sections — create from a template, bind cards and body rows to live variables. Holds no cards of its own.

label: 🏭 Factory Model
description: Software/Agentic Factory meta-model — Vision, Portfolio, Epic, Feature, Story, linked to existing SDLC/regulatory artefacts (draft, see AgentCase_Spec_FactoryMetaModel.md)

label: 🚀 Release Pipeline
description: Release, Release Candidate, Approval, Deployment, Environment promotion, Monitoring, Feedback, Backlog — a separate flow from the Business/Delivery tree (draft, see AgentCase_Spec_FactoryMetaModel.md)

label: ⚙️ Engineering
description: Commit, Build, Build Artifact, Quality Gate, Integrated Product — illustrative, user-entered counters (no live CI/CD integration) (draft, see AgentCase_Spec_FactoryMetaModel.md)

label: 📅 Factory Timeline
description: Business-chain structure (Vision/Portfolio/Epic/Feature) + a real calendar timeline of Release-pipeline/Engineering events — a NEW, separate section; the 📅 Gantt / Timeline (SDLC schedule) is untouched (draft, see AgentCase_Spec_FactoryMetaModel.md)

label: 💼 Commercial model
description: Effort & Tools, AI-Augmented Humans, Agentshore T0/T1/T2, Gain sharing — client view vs Capgemini margin (EV-07)

label: 🔀 Scenarios
description: 6 strategies side-by-side: AS-IS, AI only, Location only, Ramp, AI+Loc, AI+100% target

label: KPI Scorecard
description: Consolidated KPIs (financial, delivery, quality)

label: AS-IS vs TO-BE
description: Before/after comparison

label: 3-way Comparison
description: Compare 3 configurations

label: Sensitivity
description: Sensitivity analysis on key parameters

label: Sources
description: External benchmarks and references

label: 📋 Results
description: Consolidated outcome: verdict, key figures, uncertainty band, savings origin, team shift

label: 📖 The story so far
description: One-page AS-IS → TO-BE narrative close: baseline vs target across team, cost, delivery and confidence — the guided sequence's own capstone, distinct from the detailed AS-IS vs TO-BE comparison tab (Story Mode, SM-SPEC v0.1 §10 Q4).

label: 🧭 Decision Intelligence
description: Confidence-conditional verdict computed from the Monte Carlo distribution

label: 📋 Evidence ledger (P6)
description: P6 - tags the provenance of the 7 P1/P3/P4 drivers, grades overall case confidence (A-D) weighted by P4 tornado influence, benchmarks it against the case stage, and ranks which assumption is worth instrumenting first (AME-SPEC P6, cross-cutting).

label: 🏆 Strategy comparison
description: 7 delivery strategies evaluated on the same core and invariants — ROI, TCO, payback, coverage, supervision, risk, agility

label: 🏛️ Architecture — Layers
description: One-screen index of the architecture: the four code layers, the Time Engine, the command bus, the Portfolio layer, persistence, the View selector, the proof layer and the registries

label: 🏛️ Architecture — Layers content
description: Full technical detail: modules and functions, data flow of one action, portfolio model, file formats, security, performance budgets, proof layer, known gaps, what changed since the legacy app

label: 🔍 Logic verification
description: Auto-tests of the model invariants

label: 🎯 Eligibility & Abaques
description: Eligibility gate, pillar × SDLC potential matrix, Abaque A/B and the verification tax (EV-13/15/27)

label: 🛡️ Verification tax (P2)
description: P2 · endogenous verification tax derived from artefact criticality class + agent reliability — replaces the flat rate with V = Vfloor(C) + κ(C)·W·(1−r), and exposes the regulatory ROI ceiling ρmax = 1−φ(C) (AME-SPEC P2).

label: 📐 Maturity & Measurement
description: SDD/tooling maturity, coaching curve & autonomy weaning, DORA/SPACE/AI/human measurement socle, governance gates & AI-BOM (EV-16/19/20/24/29)

label: 🧭 Program & Completeness
description: Pilot sizing, internal capability (Volet A), multi-pod/SAFe overhead, IP/sovereignty synthesis, maturity transition criteria, token cache (EV-14/18/21/22/26/28)

label: 🛡️ Risk & Compliance
description: Agentic risk register, EU AI-Act tier classifier and the AI code-quality risk premium (EV-17/23/25)

label: 🗺️ Reference Map
description: Coverage of the delivery model by reference subchapter: summary, status and a link to the AgentCase section

label: 🔗 Section Dependencies
description: Dependency & impact matrix over the sections that drive the calculation chain (row impacts column)

label: 🗄️ Data Model
description: What data AgentCase actually holds: the section catalogue, the persisted state registry, the bindable variable registry, and the tunable coefficients + model-engine namespaces — each table live and introspected, not hand-maintained.

label: ⚙️ Calculation Engine
description: The machinery behind the numbers: the Time Engine function surface, its model() overlay contract and which sections actually reach it, plus the DEP invalidation graph and the AUDIT invariant registry with its armed/dormant split — all live-introspected.

label: 📖 Delivery-model glossary
description: Full referential vocabulary carried in AgentCase: categorised, searchable, term-by-term mapping (EV-12)

label: 📥 Import / Export
description: Round-trip Excel export/import of the full client configuration, HTML snapshot save, and the named in-file snapshot library (capture, activate, delete, baseline, snapshot-backed Excel export)

label: 🗂️ Session manager
description: Browser-native autosave and multi-tab session recovery (IndexedDB) — independent of the Snapshot library and HTML exports above; nothing here is ever written to disk

label: 🧾 Due diligence
description: Every element requiring client confirmation for the model to be defensible: inputs, metric anchors and the embedded coefficients that drive the euro result

label: 👥 Persona management
description: Advanced-only: create/edit/delete personas, assign sections to a group and order

label: 🎨 Brand & theme
description: The theme library of the case: built-in and own themes (colours, shape, density, typography, controls), live preview with contrast checks, the active theme and the ?theme= link

label: 🏢 Organisation
description: The organisation that delivers the case: organisation units (tree, keyboard-editable), the teams (the products' entry teams and shared team lines) and the role catalogue; roles and FTE only, no named people

label: 🧭 Who does what
description: The RACI of each activity (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed, and the agent), with its checks (no Responsible, Accountable to confirm, role not staffed for a product) and the views by activity, role, team, unit and product

label: 📦 Products
description: The products of the portfolio: name, wave, entry team, inherited / overridden state and key indicators; add, rename, duplicate, archive, remove, note and offset, and the active product

label: 🧬 Overrides
description: Per product, the keys that differ from the common values (common vs product value); back to common, apply to all products

label: 🔁 Knowledge transfer
description: The Knowledge Hub shared by the portfolio and its subset per product: starting and target CC, domains, KT setup and yearly cost, KT days avoided, preparation before the wave, hub effect per product and per wave; hub settings and infrastructure allocation

label: 🌊 Waves
description: The wave board: waves as columns (create, rename, reorder, delete, start month), products as cards moved by drag and drop or keyboard, per-product offset, consolidated totals per wave

label: 📈 Consolidation
description: The portfolio trajectory on the calendar: headline cards, cumulative cash by month (portfolio and waves), tables by wave and by product with totals equal to the portfolio headline, yearly flows and diagnostics

label: 🎲 Portfolio stress
description: Monte Carlo of the planned products with a global correlation rho (0 = independent, 1 = common shocks): portfolio distribution, P10/P50/P90, CVaR, P(net<0), risk reduction against the products taken alone, per wave and per product; the portfolio verdict reads it
